name: Museums of Rabat
hero_subtitle: Archaeology and fine arts in the capital — context for Chellah, the kasbah and modern Morocco.

overview.title: Indoor depth for a monument-heavy city
overview.p1: Rabat concentrates national collections that explain the objects behind sites like Chellah and the wider history of Morocco. Depending on openings, you may visit the archaeology museum and contemporary spaces such as the Mohammed VI Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art. Indoor time is ideal at midday when outdoor sites are hottest.
overview.p2: Check current hours before you go; some museums close on Mondays or for exhibition changes.

food.title: Eating near the museums
food.p1: Hassan and Agdal have the densest café and restaurant choices around museum clusters.
food.p2: Plan lunch in the same district as the museum you visit.
food.li1: Agdal cafés for a modern break.
food.li3: Avenue Mohammed V for quick options.
food.li5: L'Imprévu when you want contemporary cooking.

2.title: Tickets
2.desc: Buy on site unless a timed entry is advertised.

3.title: Combine
3.desc: One museum slot plus Hassan or Chellah makes a balanced day.

q1.question: Which museum first?
q1.answer: Archaeology if you care about Chellah’s Roman layer; modern art if you prefer contemporary work.

q2.question: English labels?
q2.answer: Often bilingual; quality varies by room.

q4.question: Children?
q4.answer: Selective rooms work better than a full multi-museum day.

q5.question: Far from the kasbah?
q5.answer: Taxi or tram depending on the exact museum.
